name: MORQA
description: Evaluating natural language generation (NLG) systems in the medical domain presents unique challenges due to the critical demands for accuracy, relevance, and domain-specific expertise. Traditional automatic evaluation metrics, such as BLEU, ROUGE, and BERTScore, often fall short in distinguishing between high-quality outputs, especially given the open-ended nature of medical question answering (QA) tasks where multiple valid responses may exist. In this work, we introduce MORQA (Medical Open-Response QA), a new multilingual benchmark designed to assess the effectiveness of NLG evaluation metrics across three medical visual and text-based QA datasets in English and Chinese. Unlike prior resources, our datasets feature 2-4+ gold-standard answers authored by medical professionals, along with expert human ratings for three English and Chinese subsets. reputation: A very recent benchmark with limited community adoption so far, mainly used as a research resource for medical NLG evaluation.
notes: New multilingual medical open-response QA benchmark; small expert-rated subsets and multiple valid answers make automatic scoring difficult.
